Match the requested metric to its biological input object and observation unit.

  require multiple sequence alignments. A FASTA suffix alone does not prove the
  sequences are aligned.

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml

id: analysis-v1

version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import base64
script = '''import io
import itertools
import statistics
import sys
import zipfile
from Bio import Phylo

archive_path = sys.argv[1]
member = \"981902at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile\"
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as zf:
    matches = [n for n in zf.namelist() if n == member]
    if len(matches) "'!= 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected exactly one {member}; found {len(matches)}")
    newick = zf.read(member).decode("utf-8")
tree = Phylo.read(io.StringIO(newick), "newick")
tips = tree.get_terminals()
names = [t.name for t in tips]
if len(tips) < 2:
    raise RuntimeError("Tree has fewer than two tips")
if any(not n for n in names) or len(set(names)) != len(names):
    raise RuntimeError("Tip names must be nonempty and unique")
for clade in tree.find_clades(order="preorder"):
    if clade is tree.root:
        continue
    if clade.branch_length is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Missing branch length for clade {clade.name!r}")
pairs = []
for a, b in itertools.combinations(tips, 2):
    pairs.append((a.name, b.name, float(tree.distance(a, b))))
values = [d for _, _, d in pairs]
median = statistics.median(values)
with open("pairwise.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write("taxon1'"\\\\ttaxon2\\\\tpatristic_distance\\\\n\")
    for a, b, d in pairs:
        out.write(f\"{a}\\\\t{b}\\\\t{d:.15g}\\\\n\")
with open(\"summary.tsv\", \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as out:
    out.write(\"gene\\\\ttree_member\\\\tn_taxa\\\\tn_unique_unordered_pairs\\\\tmetric\\\\tmedian_patristic_distance\\\\n\")
    out.write(f\"981902at2759\\\\t{member}\\\\t{len(tips)}\\\\t{len(pairs)}\\\\tmedian_of_unique_unordered_tip_pair_path_lengths\\\\t{median:.15g}\\\\n\")
'''
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())
PY"
